name: Coding-Flavoured
description: Nine teasers with a programmer's twist. Pure reasoning, no code to run.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Nine coding-flavoured teasers, solved by reasoning alone, shown on Brain Teasers.
help.goal: Nothing to win. Think it over, then reveal the answer when you are ready.
howToPlay: Read the teaser and take your time.
Press Hint for a nudge, if there is one.
Press Reveal answer to see the answer and why.
Optionally mark I got it or Not this time. This stays private.
tips: No code is run and nothing needs to be typed. It is all thinking.
